Can I have your first and last name please [Jasmine Woods] ... can I please have the address of the new place? evidence_quotes.their_agenda: What are your biggest concerns aside from the rate, the pricing, what are your biggest concerns for this upcoming move and what are the most important things you want answers to on this call today?
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Rep followed up on damage concerns: 'Our movers are not daily contracted workers. They are well vetted and professionally trained.' Then when customer raised artwork framing issue: 'You can definitely let us know later on if you're going to take care of it yourself especially that there are artworks, you know, special pieces.' And probed multiple times on furniture/items across living room, kitchen, and bedrooms with repeated 'Anything else' follow-ups.

However, did not deliver a full reflective summary like 'So what I'm hearing is X, Y, and Z—did I get all of it?'
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (apartment/house), floor/stories (2nd floor, 2-story house), bedrooms (2 bedrooms, 4 bedrooms), walking distance (120-150 feet estimated), additional items (balcony with 2 chairs and table, 3 TVs, artwork), special considerations (foldable walking pad, weights, filing cabinet), additional stops (none identified but not explicitly asked).
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Would you like help packing your smaller items in two boxes, kitchen stuff, wardrobe papers?

So in your case since you know, you are moving from a second floor apartment with elevator access to a two story house... I would estimate estimate the packing and the moving for two days total ing of 11.5 hours. So everything is included in this hourly rate like fuel and tracks, taxes, insurance, all wrap pads... The only thing outside of the order rate is the packing cost... there are no hidden fees of any type, no credit card fees, no transportation fees... We have a two and a half hour minimum and once we go over that minimum the time is prorated in fifteen minute increments.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Rep did not ask 'Does that feel fair?' Instead, moved directly into follow-up questions: 'do you have questions or clarifications about that?' and continued talking through material costs without genuine pause.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: We have the on time guarantee. So if we can't make it in the time window that we arrange, we immediately start discounting money of your final bill and all of that is included at no extra cost.

[Earlier:] With Einstein you can get up to $2,000 per move for repair replacement or reimburse for accidental damages... [Customer responded with request to email quotes instead.] Later: 'would you like your help to get on the schedule today for the October 7th and October 8th?' evidence_quotes.rate_lock: No deposit ma'am... there's no risk and securing your spot. So as I said if something comes up or things change on your end that you can always, always call us to reschedule with a quick call and no fees for that.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Email confirmed: Jasmine m.wood @yahoo.com. Move dates confirmed: October 7th and 8th (after customer requested moving them up). Floor runners mentioned for new house protection. Crew size implied (two movers) but not explicitly confirmed. Addresses on file from earlier in call. No explicit crew notes documented about customer concerns (damage, artwork, floor protection noted verbally but not confirmed as written to crew).

top_strength: Jevic did excellent two-layer discovery and follow-up on concerns—when the customer raised damage fears and artwork handling, he both addressed immediately with the damage coverage promise and then continued probing for more details throughout the furniture walkthrough, never rushing past a hesitation.
coaching_note: The call ended without a binding commitment: the rep offered the ask twice but accepted 'email me the quotes' both times without pivoting to a close or rate-lock confirmation, leaving the customer unbooked and requiring a follow-up callback to actually schedule.
